enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Illusion Focus +1: +1 Insight bonus to the DC of Illusion spells.
Insightful Enchantment Focus +1: +1 Insight bonus to the DC of Enchantment spells.
Insightful Spell Save +1: This item gives a +1 Insight bonus to your saves versus spells.
Insightful Spell Resistance +5: +5 Insight bonus to Spell Resistance.
Mythic Belt Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
